summary: Re-enables three long-disabled tests in JdbcTest and RelMetadataTest, updating the expected plan and selectivity to current optimizer output.

tests.evidence: The whole change is test expectations; reviewer utafrali asked to un-split the plan string literals (done in the final diff), and mihaibudiu noted the plan is very hard for a human to verify and would be better as a quidem test with data.

change_description.evidence: Title and description explain each re-enabled test and why; test-only change owes no changelog entry.

performance.evidence: No code changes, but the expected plan now pins a cartesian-product join; worth a glance whether the test should assert a better plan rather than whatever the planner emits.

correctness.evidence: RelMetadataTest expectation 1.0 / DEPT_SIZE matches the fixed 4-row dept table; nothing wrong found, only the plan expectation needs a glance.

contradictions.evidence: The description calls the new plan 'more optimized', yet the locked-in expected plan contains EnumerableNestedLoopJoin(condition=[true]) (a cross product of time/sales with product_class) under a semi-join, so the test freezes a plan that contradicts the claim and may hide an optimizer regression.

plan.why: Small test-only change; one reviewer can judge the expectations and the description claim together.
